notes.title: Eufloria Classic Coming Soon on Steam!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to reveal a renewal of the much-loved, Bafta nominated franchise Eufloria! Set to launch imminently on Steam, [b]Eufloria Classic[/b] will bring back the original charms of the long-unavailable indie classic, updated for a new age with a plethora of new content and features, including [b]extreme moddability[/b]. The release marks the return of the Eufloria genus, with more original titles currently under development. Keep your eyes open, as more will be revealed very soon!

[h2]Original Features: [/h2]
[list]
[*] 25 level Single player campaign
[*] 8 Level “Skirmish Mode”
[*] Unlockable “Dark Matter” mode
[*] Hours of wonderful ambient music by “Milieu”
[*] Procedural levels – great for replayability
[*] Community levels
[/list]
[h2]New Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New “Survivalist” Game Mode
[*] New Peaceful “Gardening Mode”
[*] New Levels
[*] New original music by “Milieu”
[*] Speedup Controls
[*] New modding features
[*] Many free bonus assets, including art, early game iterations & more 
[/list]
Wishlist Eufloria classic now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3254570/Eufloria_Classic/ 

We are also delighted to announce that the demo for Omni Systems Ltd new title, [b]Bioframe Outpost[/b], is available now. Head to store page and try it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/463730/Bioframe_Outpost/ 

Bioframe Outpost touches on similar themes as Eufloria, offering musings on evolution, conflict, and nature - this time through the lens of a photography-based Metroidvania. Bioframe even contains Eufloria related Easter eggs!

notes.title: Release Notes V1.2.0 (Windows/MacOSX)
notes.content:
Right mouse drag (shortcut) - from one asteroid to another will send all of your units from the source to the target asteroid in a single operation.

Updated to use SDL2 - for better fullscreen switching, window handling and joystick support (including XInput).

OS User Names - containing umlauts should now save progress and options correctly.

Added joystick support when activating artifacts.

Higher resolution title logo.

Mac: Retina Support.

Bug fixes.

Note: Any existing joystick mappings will be reset on the first run and will need reconfiguring (if you have any customisations) - this is due to SDL2 mapping controllers differently from the previous version.
